text: PR #6919 review found two actionable gaps: ordinary SUBSTRC calls unnecessarily built a second full scalar-offset vector, and tests omitted the positive wrapped-start-before-end case. Both are fixed; 2^32+1 is pinned and scalar counting now occurs only in the huge-positive VFP9 branch. All three focused suites pass normally and under ASan/UBSan/float-cast-overflow.
